description: Unique identifier for a customer record
business_meaning: Primary key for joining/tracking a customer
possible_data_quality_problem: Not unique across rows — some IDs repeat due to duplicate/re-entered records

description: Date the customer created their account
business_meaning: Used to compute tenure/customer age on platform
possible_data_quality_problem: Multiple date formats mixed together; a few invalid/nonsensical date strings

description: Self-reported gender of the customer
possible_data_quality_problem: Inconsistent casing/abbreviations (Male/male/M/m), missing values with varied tokens, stray whitespace

description: Customer's age in years
business_meaning: Used for demographic analysis and targeting
possible_data_quality_problem: Stored sometimes as string, missing values, and a few impossible values (e.g. negative, 0, 150+)

description: Country of the customer's registered address
business_meaning: Used for regional analysis and localization
possible_data_quality_problem: Same country expressed multiple ways (USA/US/United States/U.S.A.), whitespace padding

description: City of the customer's registered address
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values, whitespace padding

description: Business-assigned customer segment (e.g. VIP, At Risk)
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values; may correlate strongly with churn (check for leakage risk)

description: Tier of paid membership the customer holds
possible_data_quality_problem: Inconsistent casing, trailing/leading whitespace, missing values

description: Marketing channel through which the customer was acquired
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values, whitespace padding

description: Primary payment method on file
business_meaning: Used for payment/fraud and preference analysis
possible_data_quality_problem: Multiple encodings for the same method (Credit Card/credit_card/CC), missing values

description: Device type most used to access the platform
possible_data_quality_problem: Inconsistent casing, missing values, whitespace

description: Primary product category the customer purchases from
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values

description: Type of subscription plan, if any
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values; 'None' represents no subscription and may be conflated with true missingness

description: Date the customer's current/most recent subscription began
possible_data_quality_problem: Mixed date formats, missing values, only applicable when subscription_type != None

description: Date the customer's subscription ends/ended
business_meaning: Used to determine active vs. expired subscription status
possible_data_quality_problem: Mixed date formats, missing values, some end dates in the past (expired) vs future (active)

description: Customer's self-reported or estimated annual income
possible_data_quality_problem: Stored as messy strings ($52,000 / 52k / 52000 USD), missing values, extreme outliers

description: Current balance held in the customer's account/wallet
possible_data_quality_problem: Messy currency-string formatting, missing values, some negative values

description: Cumulative amount spent by the customer to date
business_meaning: Core monetary metric of customer value
possible_data_quality_problem: Messy currency-string formatting, missing values, some negative values that shouldn't be possible

description: Average value per order for the customer
business_meaning: Derived spending metric, useful for segmentation
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values, potential inconsistency with total_spending/number_of_orders

description: Total number of completed orders
possible_data_quality_problem: Stored sometimes as string with thousands separators, some negative and zero values, some extreme outliers

description: Number of days elapsed since the customer's last order
possible_data_quality_problem: Extreme outliers (multi-year inactivity), possible inconsistency with last_purchase_date

description: Date of the customer's most recent purchase
possible_data_quality_problem: Mixed date formats, missing values, may be missing for customers with 0 orders (expected) or unexpectedly missing otherwise

description: Date of the customer's most recent platform login
possible_data_quality_problem: Mixed date formats, missing values

description: Count of website/app visits in the observed period
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values, some implausibly large outlier counts (bot-like activity)

description: Number of customer support tickets raised
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values

description: Number of times the customer used a discount/coupon code
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values

description: Total monetary amount refunded to the customer
possible_data_quality_problem: Messy currency-string formatting, missing values

description: Estimated total value of the customer over their tenure
possible_data_quality_problem: Missing values, may be derived from other spending fields (check for redundancy/leakage)

description: Reason given for cancelling, if applicable
possible_data_quality_problem: Populated almost exclusively for churned customers — strong potential data leakage column

description: Date the customer's cancellation was recorded
possible_data_quality_problem: Populated almost exclusively for churned customers — strong potential data leakage column; mixed date formats

description: Most recent known status of the customer's account
possible_data_quality_problem: Values like 'Closed'/'Cancelled'/'Deactivated' appear almost only for churned customers — potential data leakage column

description: Target variable: whether the customer churned
business_meaning: Prediction target for the modeling task
possible_data_quality_problem: Class imbalance present; treat as ground truth label, not a feature
